changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-hot-to-hook-clip skill.
- Converts Douyin hot search topics into short (2–15s) talking hook clips, one per still image provided.
- Accepts hard inputs: Douyin hot search topic (either from board or pasted), confirmed brand/product info, at least one still, likeness/voice rights, and desired number of clips (defaults to 3).
- Stages work via labeled planning, live trend lookup, optional voice cloning, text-to-speech synthesis, and final image-to-video animation, each requiring explicit approval and showing live price per stage.
- Ensures clips are never stitched; each remains a standalone talking hook, always opening with the original image.
- Adheres strictly to seller-provided facts; never invents data such as topic, rank, or offer.
summary: Turn a Douyin hot search topic into one talking hook clip per still.
